title: Rendering vectors
summary: A small dictionary whose only job is to contain every case the text rendering has a rule for.

ALERTS_API_KEY.description: API key for alerts.example.com, held by the executor.

nodes.title: Price alerts
nodes.summary: Create, list and delete alerts that fire when a token crosses a price.
sampleQueries: tell me when a token goes above a price

nodes.title: Diagnostics
nodes.summary: Tools that report on the service itself rather than on market data.

children.title: Probes
children.summary: Liveness and version checks reached over MCP.

entries.name: alert_create
entries.title: Create a price alert
entries.summary: Watch a token and notify the caller when its price crosses a threshold.
entries.description: The alert fires once and is then inactive; recreate it to watch again. Thresholds are in USD and are compared against the same price feed token_price reads.

threshold.description: Price in USD that triggers the alert.

note.description: Free text echoed back when the alert fires.

entries.returns: The created alert, with its id and the price it is watching.

relations.reason: the same id is what cancels it

cost.note: Counts against the alert quota, not the query quota.

entries.name: alert_delete
entries.title: Delete a price alert
entries.summary: Cancel an alert so it never fires.

entries.name: alert_create_v0
entries.title: Create a price alert (legacy)
entries.summary: The pre-2026 alert endpoint, kept alive for callers that have not migrated.

relations.reason: same alert, and it accepts a direction

deprecation.note: Removed once the last caller migrates.

entries.name: probe_upstream
entries.title: Probe the upstream feed
entries.summary: Report whether the price feed is live and how far behind it is.
entries.returns: Liveness plus the age in seconds of the newest price.

entries.name: echo_request
entries.title: Echo a request back
entries.summary: Return the request exactly as the service received it, for debugging a caller.

text.description: Anything; it comes back unchanged — quotes, "nested" ones included.
